description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect You hype yourself up and attempt to convince your audience to give you a round of applause, using over exaggerated gestures and excessive enthusiasm. You gain 1d4 temporary Hit points that last for 1 minute. Each of your allies within 60 feet can choose to applaud for you as a reaction. For each ally who applauds, increase the number of temporary Hit Points you gain by 1. At 9th level and every 5 levels thereafter, the initial temporary Hit Points increase by 1d4, and the applause temporary Hit Points per ally increase by 1.
